title: SigBase pocket relational DB
description: Signature Pocket Base is a Signature original: a zero-configuration embedded relational database in a single file, with ACID transactions, full-text search, JSON support, and a geospatial extension — the Signature take on the embedded database. Its file format, SQL dialect extensions, and geo module are original Signature designs.

demo.program:
print('SigBase: one file, full SQL, zero config')
print('edition: Signature original')

SigBase: one file, full SQL, zero config
edition: Signature original
